representation_plans.learner_operation: Classify what lies inside the boundary and whether each quantity belongs to a state or a process.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Provide a text table listing the system, surroundings, permitted boundary transfers, endpoint variables, and process transfers.
